info.name: Group Chat WebSocket Events

request.description:
Establish initial Socket.IO WebSocket connection.

**WebSocket URL:** `{{wsUrl}}?userId={{userId}}`

**Steps:**
1. Set the WebSocket URL with your userId as query parameter
2. Click Connect
3. Wait for connection confirmation

**Expected Response on Connection:**
```json
{
  "message": "User Successfully Connected With Socket"
}
```

**Response Event:** `success`

**Error:** `exception` event if user not found

Create a new group chat room.

**Emit Event:** `create-group-chat`

**Send this payload:**
```json
{
  "name": "My Group",
  "image": "https://example.com/group-image.png",
  "memberIds": ["member-id-1", "member-id-2"]
}
```

**Field Details:**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| name | string | ✅ | Group name |
| image | string | ❌ | Group avatar URL |
| memberIds | string[] | ✅ | Array of user IDs to add |

**You will receive `success` event:**
```json
{
  "message": "Group chat created successfully",
  "groupChat": {
    "id": "group-id",
    "name": "My Group",
    "image": "https://example.com/group-image.png",
    "group_members_count": 3,
    "members": [...]
  }
}
```

Update group chat room details. Only admin can update.

**Emit Event:** `update-group-chat`

**Send this payload:**
```json
{
  "groupChatRoomId": "{{groupChatRoomId}}",
  "updateData": {
    "name": "Updated Group Name",
    "image": "https://example.com/new-image.png"
  }
}
```

**Field Details:**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| groupChatRoomId | string | ✅ | Target group ID |
| updateData.name | string | ❌ | New group name |
| updateData.image | string | ❌ | New group image URL |

**Broadcast to all members - `group-updated` event:**
```json
{
  "message": "Group information updated",
  "updatedGroup": {...},
  "updatedBy": "user-id",
  "groupChatRoomId": "group-id"
}
```

Join a group chat Socket.IO room to receive real-time updates.

**Emit Event:** `join-group-chat`

**Send this payload:**
```json
{
  "groupChatRoomId": "{{groupChatRoomId}}"
}
```

**Field Details:**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| groupChatRoomId | string | ✅ | Group to join |

**You receive - `success` event:**
```json
{
  "message": "Successfully joined group chat"
}
```

**Others in group receive - `success` event:**
```json
{
  "message": "User <userId> joined the group",
  "userId": "user-id",
  "groupChatRoomId": "group-id"
}
```

Leave a group chat Socket.IO room.

**Emit Event:** `leave-group-chat`

**Send this payload:**
```json
{
  "groupChatRoomId": "{{groupChatRoomId}}"
}
```

**Field Details:**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| groupChatRoomId | string | ✅ | Group to leave |

**You receive - `success` event:**
```json
{
  "message": "Successfully left group chat"
}
```

**Others receive - `success` event:**
```json
{
  "message": "User <userId> left the group",
  "userId": "user-id",
  "groupChatRoomId": "group-id"
}
```

Add a new member to the group. Only admin can add.

**Emit Event:** `add-group-member`

**Send this payload:**
```json
{
  "groupChatRoomId": "{{groupChatRoomId}}",
  "newMemberId": "{{targetMemberId}}"
}
```

**Field Details:**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| groupChatRoomId | string | ✅ | Target group ID |
| newMemberId | string | ✅ | User ID to add |

**Broadcast to all members - `group-member-added` event:**
```json
{
  "message": "<nick_name> was added to the group",
  "newMember": {
    "id": "membership-id",
    "user_id": "new-member-id",
    "group_role": "GROUP_MEMBER",
    "user": {
      "id": "new-member-id",
      "nick_name": "Jane",
      "avatar": "avatar-url"
    }
  },
  "groupChatRoomId": "group-id"
}
```

Remove a member from the group. Only admin can remove others.

**Emit Event:** `remove-group-member`

**Send this payload:**
```json
{
  "groupChatRoomId": "{{groupChatRoomId}}",
  "memberId": "{{targetMemberId}}"
}
```

**Field Details:**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| groupChatRoomId | string | ✅ | Target group ID |
| memberId | string | ✅ | User ID to remove |

**Broadcast to all members - `group-member-removed` event:**
```json
{
  "message": "Member was removed from the group",
  "memberId": "removed-member-id",
  "removedBy": "admin-user-id",
  "groupChatRoomId": "group-id"
}
```

Send a message to a group chat.

**Emit Event:** `send-group-message`

**Send this payload:**
```json
{
  "groupChatRoomId": "{{groupChatRoomId}}",
  "message": "Hello group!"
}
```

**Field Details:**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| groupChatRoomId | string | ✅ | Target group ID |
| message | string | ✅ | Message content |

**You receive - `group-message-sent` event:**
```json
{
  "id": "message-id",
  "groupChatRoom_id": "group-id",
  "sender_id": "user-id",
  "message": "Hello group!",
  "createdAt": "2026-05-06T03:00:00.000Z",
  "sender": {
    "id": "user-id",
    "nick_name": "John",
    "avatar": "avatar-url"
  },
  "is_mine": true
}
```

**Others receive - `group-new-message` event:**
```json
{
  "id": "message-id",
  "groupChatRoom_id": "group-id",
  "sender_id": "user-id",
  "message": "Hello group!",
  "createdAt": "2026-05-06T03:00:00.000Z",
  "sender": {...},
  "is_mine": false
}
```

Fetch paginated messages for a group chat.

**Emit Event:** `fetch-group-messages`

**Send this payload:**
```json
{
  "groupChatRoomId": "{{groupChatRoomId}}",
  "pagination": {
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 10
  }
}
```

**Field Details:**
| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|-------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| groupChatRoomId | string | ✅ | - | Target group ID |
| pagination.page | number | ❌ | 1 | Page number |
| pagination.limit | number | ❌ | 10 | Items per page |

**You receive - `group-messages` event:**
```json
{
  "messages": [
    {
      "id": "message-id",
      "groupChatRoom_id": "group-id",
      "sender_id": "user-id",
      "message": "Hello!",
      "createdAt": "2026-05-06T03:00:00.000Z",
      "sender": {...},
      "is_mine": true
    }
  ],
  "total": 25
}
```

Fetch all group chat rooms the user belongs to. Also auto-joins all group Socket.IO rooms.

**Emit Event:** `fetch-group-chat-rooms`

**Send this payload:**
```json
{
  "page": 1,
  "limit": 10
}
```

**Field Details:**
| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|-------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| page | number | ❌ | 1 | Page number |
| limit | number | ❌ | 10 | Items per page |

**You receive - `group-chat-rooms` event:**
```json
{
  "rooms": [
    {
      "id": "group-id",
      "name": "My Group",
      "image": "image-url",
      "group_members_count": 5,
      "createdAt": "2026-05-06T03:00:00.000Z",
      "updatedAt": "2026-05-06T03:00:00.000Z",
      "members": [...],
      "chats": [...]
    }
  ],
  "total": 3
}
```

Notify group members that you are typing.

**Emit Event:** `group-typing`

**Send this payload:**
```json
{
  "groupChatRoomId": "{{groupChatRoomId}}"
}
```

**Field Details:**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| groupChatRoomId | string | ✅ | Target group ID |

**Others in group receive - `group-user-typing` event:**
```json
{
  "userId": "user-id",
  "groupChatRoomId": "group-id"
}
```

**Tip:** Send this event while user is typing, then send `group-stop-typing` when they stop or send a message.

Notify group members that you stopped typing.

**Emit Event:** `group-stop-typing`

**Send this payload:**
```json
{
  "groupChatRoomId": "{{groupChatRoomId}}"
}
```

**Field Details:**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| groupChatRoomId | string | ✅ | Target group ID |

**Others in group receive - `group-user-stopped-typing` event:**
```json
{
  "userId": "user-id",
  "groupChatRoomId": "group-id"
}
```
